reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in extending classical Gibbs weighting to include diversity corrections and online hyperparameter adaptation. The generalized form uses normalized predictive losses to ensure comparability across datasets, then applies exponential weighting with optional directional or symmetric diversity bonuses. These corrections enhance ensemble robustness by penalizing redundant models and rewarding complementary ones. The Local-UCB mechanism dynamically selects optimal (η, λ, variant) tuples based on recent performance, allowing adaptation to changing model skill distributions. This framework bridges static ensemble methods with adaptive learning, offering a principled way to handle nonstationarity in forecasting. Failure modes include overfitting due to excessive diversity rewards, instability from noisy UCB estimates, and breakdown when normalization fails under extreme loss variations.
